Done. This morning's rules are live on the Cup race and the three NFL games still to come. No resting orders were lost. 1) Rows above the crowd make room for rows at the crowd's price only once that side's crowd is mostly in. 2) Near kickoff or green the bot first tries taking, then buys back toward your comfort level within half the expected profit. 3) Non-primetime games get a worst case leash; Packers-Patriots already trimmed its oversized rows. 4) New: whenever selling every side at once beats 1.00 after fees, the bot takes as many as it can, in small batches so a half-filled batch costs at most about $50. Right now bids add up to only 0.68 to 0.95, so it waits for a price swing. I left the live Bengals game alone, since restarting mid-game is risky and it would not fire there now. Say the word if you want it anyway.
